prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pour the colored silicone mixture from the test tube into the mold at the center of tray.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: tray
What the inspection checks: Check whether the mold at the center of tray contains uniformly mixed silicone mixture.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A close, angled view into a square white translucent tray or workspace with raised walls, sitting on a grey benchtop. Inside the tray floor are several small round metal inserts or screw heads (one near each side/corner and one at the front), arranged around the centre. At the centre of the tray sits a small square block, white at its base with a teal/green top surface containing four round wells or recesses in a 2x2 pattern; the wells appear empty. Black-and-white printed fiducial markers are attached to the left and lower-left edges of the tray. Behind the tray are white plastic frame pieces with metal bolts and vertical posts, part of a larger rig.
observations: The mold at the tray center shows four wells in a 2x2 pattern that appear empty, with no silicone mixture visible in them. This indicates the pour did not deliver mixture into the mold.
